propositions: GitHub Actions in the Verified-gate vote path (gerrit-verify.yaml and its five reusable workflows) contained mutable action references (checkout@v7, setup-python@v7) that were not SHA-pinned, contradicting the documented pinning claim

The zizmor security audit covered only release.yml but not gerrit-verify.yaml or its reusable workflows, leaving credential-persistence and template-injection vulnerabilities undetected on the authoritative Verified vote path
Twine package metadata validation ran only at release time, allowing packaging regressions to receive Verified+1 approval before failing at publish
_artifact-probe.yml lacks the twine tool needed to run `twine check --strict` on built artifacts pre-merge without adding new CI jobs
The matrix.shard value in _mutation.yml is passed directly into build commands, creating a template-injection surface that must be hardened via env indirection
